48.original: You're part of the Third Promise's retinue, aren't you? I was glad to hear you express an interest in our ways.

49.original: Perhaps you'd be interested in learning more about our culture? I could teach you, if you'd like.

50.original: The statue behind me holds great cultural significance to our people. Feel free to ask about anything that catches your interest.

51.original: The statue behind me represents much and more about Mamook. Take a look from over there and I'll explain whatever you're curious about.

52.original: Study the statue of blessed siblings. You may move the camera, as well as zoom in and out. Target a section and learn more details with <hex:020825E4E95101FF10024804F2022203EE81910248020103FF0E021E021003202F20021E02090303>.

53.original: In conclusion, this statue symbolizes the heart of Mamook, down to the stone it was carved from─the very stone left by the Yok Huy who ruled these lands long ago.

54.original: Our predecessors reimagined the structures abandoned here and built the city you see today, creating a future all their own.

55.original: ...Unlike their descendants, now shackled to a past, land, and practice that have poisoned Mamook's prospects. I wonder if we are truly capable of change.

56.original: But no─as our ancestors found their way, so will we. As we seek to discover what we might yet become, I pray you never forget all that Mamook once was.
